Name: Rimmon in Simeon
ModernLocation: Unknown; possibly Tel Halif, in Simeon's allotment
Description: A Simeonite town named in the allotment lists, also called En-rimmon in Nehemiah; Zechariah pictures the land from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem.
BiblicalSignificance: Rimmon in Simeon is a southern town of the allotments, later a landmark in Zechariah's picture of Jerusalem's plain.
